field_description: ENA secondary sample accession, Sample, XRS
Sample or isolate id used internally in publication. One row per each table/tab mentioned in source_field.
Other IDs associated with this isolate or strain. Separate with '; ' if more than one
Geographical source of samples location (e.g. hospital, river, farm...)

Geographical source of samples location coordinates (e.g. hospital, river, farm…). Specify as degrees latitude and longitude in format "d[d.dddd] N|S d[dd.dddd] W|E", (e.g. 38.98 N 77.11 W) or if info in different columns use format “lat; long” (e.g. column1;  column2)
The date on which the sample was collected. Data format: dd/mm/yyyy or mm/yyyy or yyyy.  If info in different columns use format “day; month; year” (e.g. column1;  column2; column3)
Scientific name of the host from which bacteria was isolated or common name if unavailable.
See BioSample for standard list of isolation sources. If info in different columns use format “source; source” (e.g. column1;  column2)
See BioSample for standard list of host diseases. If info in different columns use format “disease; disease” (e.g. column1;  column2)
See BioSample for standard list of host tissue sampled.
A unique identifier by which each subject from which bacteria was isolated can be referred to, de-identified (e.g. #131, patient3)
Information that doesn't fit anywhere else
